title: Either will do

brief.story: A stairwell light should come on from the switch at the bottom OR the one at the top. SA, the bottom switch, is in. The top one still needs fitting.
brief.goal: Fit a second switch so LED1 lights when SA or your switch (or both) is on: an OR gate.

hints: In OR, either switch alone has to be enough: two separate paths side by side, in parallel.
SA joins the + rail to column 2. Your switch has to do the same: one leg on the + rail, one in column 2.
Take a toggle and click a + rail hole near the start (T+), then a free hole in column 2.

spec.label: LED1 = SA OR your switch
spec.explain: Parallel switches: two paths, so either one closed is enough.

debrief: Two switches side by side make OR: either path is enough. (A real stairwell uses two changeover switches so each one can also turn it off: that's XOR, and it's coming.)
